fact: A Gambian ministry official named the National ICT for Development Policy Statement 2018-2028 as an existing Gambian ICT policy in October 2026; the statement is dated by the article's publication date.

A Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy presentation lists the ICT4D Policy Statement 2018-2028 among the Gambia's policies, strategies and legal frameworks and sets out its nine priority areas; the document gives no date beyond its 2025 publication, which is used.
